name: The level 60 balance dungeon's boss stage fights normally; Ramstein the Gorger does not
contract: dungeons.json's level 60 row used Ramstein the Gorger (10439, Stratholme) as the boss. Ramstein's own smart_scripts On Reset (entryorguid 10439, id 0) always runs timed actionlist 1043900, whose id 1 sets unit flags 768 (UNIT_FLAG_IMMUNE_TO_PC|UNIT_FLAG_IMMUNE_TO_NPC) and only removes them at id 6/7 (Remove Unit Flags/Attack Start), roughly 6s later in the real Baron Rivendare gauntlet - a cinematic intro, not a standalone-boss delay. Spawned directly by balance_stage at a fixed fight spot, Ramstein carries UNIT_FLAG_IMMUNE_TO_PC from the first tick: ThreatReference::FlagsAllowFighting (ThreatManager.cpp) marks any threat reference against a player offline while that flag holds, so ThreatManager::ReselectVictim's only reference is never available, Unit::SelectVictim finds no acceptable target and calls AI()->EnterEvadeMode() on the very next update - matching final-run-1's recorded boss stage (duration_s 0.017, health_pct_end 100, zero damage either side, outcome invalid) for all 70 level 60 cases. ramstein_immune_intro_evades reproduces this directly against the historical boss entry and pins it down as invalid so the defect cannot silently return. Maleki the Pallid (10438), the row's replacement boss, is a standalone Stratholme SmartAI caster with no On Reset actions and no unit-flag toggling, so boss_stage_fights_normally spawning him at the same fight spot must leave Running within the stage cap and end with both sides having exchanged damage.
